sloka: वाजिमुख्या मनुष्याश्च मत्ताश्च वरवारणा: ।प्रच्छाद्य भगवन् भूमिं महतीमनुयान्ति माम् ॥ २.९१.८॥
transliteration: vājimukhyā manuṣyāśca mattāśca varavāraṇā: ।pracchādya bhagavan bhūmiṁ mahatīmanuyānti mām ॥ 2.91.8॥

translations.english: O venerable sage spirited horses, men and mighty rutting elephants follow me covering a wide expanse of land.
